summary: Customer is unable to access loan balance online.

intents.keywords: I tried checking my loan balance online but it says...account not found help

issues.issue: Customer is unable to access their loan account online.
issues.reason(s): Account is not linked to the online portal.

intents.actions of agent: Agent confirmed the account number and offered to link the account to the portal and provide login instructions and a guide.
intents.resolution: Agent will link the account and send login instructions and guide.

intents.keywords: Ok but I am not good with these online things will it be easy?

issues.issue: Customer expresses concern about ease of use of online portal.
issues.reason(s): Customer is not comfortable with online systems.

intents.actions of agent: Agent reassured the customer that it is simple, will send a guide, and offered further assistance via call.
intents.resolution: Agent reassures customer and offers support.
